b: I've been doing a lot of cardio over the past few months, and honestly, aside from medication, nothing has been as effective for me as cardiovascular exercise. I've been doing around five hours a week, most of it at moderate intensity (Zone 2).

The biggest difference I've noticed is that I feel much calmer mentally. My brain doesn't jump from one thought to another or from one task to the next nearly as much. I've also noticed that initiating tasks has become easier and doesn't require nearly as much mental effort as it used to.
And also it helps me tolerate the cold weather, normally the colder months are pretty depressing to me but now I'm actually perfectly fine.
Of course for alot of people doing that much exercise isn't practical but the research even shows that much lower volume like 150 minutes per week can help.
